newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung starts TFT LCD filter production.
newsitem.headline: Samsung starts TFT LCD filter production.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Display Devices Co Ltd, an affiliate of Samsung Group, said on Tuesday it has begun mass production of colour filters for thin film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT LCDs).
Monthly production of colour filters for TFT LCDs is set at 44,000, a company statement said.
Samsung has become the first in South Korea to develop and begin mass production of colour filters for TFT LCDs, it said.
Localised production is expected to save South Korean industry $100 million in import costs this year.

Samsung, which has spent 130 billion won for the mass production, is investing an additional 100 billion won to build another production line, which is scheduled to start up next year. The colour filter is a key component for controlling the colour and brightness of images on TFT LCDs, which are used in notebook PCs, monitors and portable televisions.
